task_input: Franka Panda's complete maintained public task library (20 entries).
request_settings: The maintained Holistic ReAct client sends temperature=0 and does not set reasoning effort. Gateway support must be checked before the batch.
scope: The initial Franka case uses one generation run through validation and export. Downstream task scenes and physical scoring are prepared separately before task execution. The wider six-robot thesis cohort is unchanged.
budget_note: The user authorised this single-generation case and its task experiment on 2026-09-14. The response limit is not a total trial token budget.

downstream_plan.condition_rule: Translate each task's fixtures, object starts and targets together; keep the robot base fixed. These proposed offsets require reachability/contact checks when the scenes are built.

tasks.name: Reaching
tasks.observation: Terminal world-frame hand-body position relative to the target.
tasks.scene_preparation: Add a fixed target to the canonical Panda scene and bind the terminal-distance scorer. Do not substitute the default fixed_tcp demo coordinates.

tasks.name: Pushing
tasks.observation: Terminal object position after physical contact-driven pushing.
tasks.scene_preparation: Reuse the Panda pushbench table/object geometry, add a goal and align the existing contact observations with the catalog goal-distance criterion.

tasks.name: Pick-and-place
tasks.observation: Object position after grasping, lifting, transport and release; record object support and gripper contact during the sequence.
tasks.scene_preparation: Use a graspable free object and a raised destination that requires lifting; add physical grasp/lift/release and terminal-position scoring.

tasks.name: Drawer opening
tasks.observation: Terminal drawer-handle position after a physical pull.
tasks.scene_preparation: Add a slide-joint drawer with a reachable handle, open-state target and handle-position/contact scoring.

tasks.name: Dial turning
tasks.observation: Terminal position of an off-axis point attached to the dial after physical rotation.
tasks.scene_preparation: Add a hinge-joint dial with a contact feature and an off-axis measurement point; score the dial rather than the robot wrist angle.

downstream_plan.initial_state_requirement: Every case must start outside its success tolerance, remain outside it without robot actions, and have a physically feasible target.
downstream_plan.execution_preparation: Complete one native AA run through export before ReCAP. Concrete scenes, parameters, physical predicates and ReCAP input JSON must be checked before the 15 task executions.
downstream_plan.interpretation: The planned 15 task executions assess one generated driver; they are not independent driver-generation replicates.
